name: Binance Staked ETH (WBETH)
description: Binance ETH staking token. WBETH is a wrapped form of staked ETH whose value grows with staking rewards through a daily exchange rate. Agents can hold, send and approve WBETH on Ethereum and BNB Chain. Staking and redemption run through Binance's ETH Staking service.

keyFunctions.description: WBETH balance of an address in base units. The balance does not change with rewards; the exchange rate does.
Current WBETH exchange rate from the contract. Rewards are added here once a day, so WBETH is worth more ETH over time. Check the verified source for the scale before converting.
Total WBETH in circulation, in base units.
Token decimals for WBETH base units.
Remaining amount a spender may pull: (owner, spender).
Approve a spender to pull WBETH: (spender, amount in base units). Needed before a protocol pulls WBETH from your wallet.
Send WBETH: (to, amount in base units). Reverts if the balance is too low.
Move WBETH from an owner to a recipient using an allowance: (from, to, amount in base units).

actions.name: hold-or-send-wbeth
actions.description: Send WBETH on Ethereum or BNB Chain
actions.how: call transfer(to, amount) on 0xa2E3356610840701BDf5611a53974510Ae27E2e1 on the right chain.

actions.name: use-wbeth-in-protocol
actions.description: Use WBETH as collateral or liquidity in DeFi
actions.how: approve(protocol, amount) on WBETH, then call that protocol's deposit function. Check the protocol's registry entry for the function.

actions.name: stake-or-redeem
actions.description: Stake ETH into WBETH or redeem WBETH to ETH
actions.how: not a plain contract call for agents. Staking and redemption run through Binance's ETH Staking service (binance.com/en/eth2), which sets the rate and timing.

risks: WBETH is issued by Binance. It depends on Binance's staking operations and its custody of the staked ETH. Binance can change terms.
The WBETH to ETH rate is updated once a day. Staking and redemption can be paused while the rate updates, so redemption is not always instant.
Rewards are reflected in the rate, not paid out as separate tokens. The value of WBETH in ETH depends on the current rate.
BETH and WBETH are different tokens. Conversion between them goes through Binance's own contracts and service, so check the token symbol before sending.
notes: The Ethereum WBETH address is the same address Binance lists for BNB Chain. The token's verified source on Etherscan is a proxy with a wBETH implementation. keyFunctions were taken from that verified ABI, not from an official Binance page, so check get_abi before a write call. BNB Chain entries have no keyFunctions on purpose. Binance's conversion contract on BNB Chain (0x250632378E573c6Be1AC2f97Fcdf00515d0Aa91B) is a different contract and is not listed.
